saw_lines: Buyers pick a backsplash by fit and finish. They measure the wall, check the cut outs, then order once for one room.
So the sale is won or lost in line one of the ad, before the buyer scrolls past.
Your site answers how shipping works, yet 0 of 12 ads mention shipping or delivery. Open new ads with delivery in plain words, taken from your shipping policy.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site answers how shipping works, yet 0 of 12 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the order. Open new ads with delivery in plain words, taken from your shipping policy.
0 of 9 copy ads carry a proof number, so a buyer has nothing concrete to trust before ordering. Collect one figure like the number of orders shipped and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

3 of 9 copy ads open on the same shower panel line, so most of the account says one thing. Test two new openers against it: the no-drill install from your Auspacken ad, and a customer’s bathroom before and after.
0 of 9 copy ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to order today. Give new buyers one reason to act now, a first order offer or a bundle, and open three new ads with it.
